title: quickmeasure: tree heights from photos with a reference stick
description: quickmeasure is a single-file web app for measuring the height of trees, or any upright object, in photographs that include a reference stick of known length standing against the object. The user marks the bottom of the stick and a known mark on it, then the base and top of each tree; the height is the tree's length in pixels scaled by the stick's pixels per metre, with an uncertainty from how precisely the points were placed. It runs entirely in the browser (photos never leave the computer), works offline, and exports heights with their source photo, reference and pixel measurements as CSV, plus a session file holding every point.
